git_alignment.head_commit_msg: ci: add PYTHONPATH env variable to test job to resolve backend packages

functions.name: build_domain
functions.description: Constructs multi-objective search space bounds, calculating glass-transition-temperature-based drying boundaries and loading dynamic excipient and process CQA targets.

functions.name: create_gp_model
functions.description: Initializes a single-task Gaussian Process surrogate model using a Matern 5/2 covariance kernel and scale wrapper.

functions.name: create_ehvi_acquisition
functions.description: Initializes standard multi-objective EHVI acquisition based on deterministic hypervolume partitioning.

functions.name: create_log_nehvi_acquisition
functions.description: Initializes noise-robust qLogNEHVI acquisition. Implements O(2^M) exponential CPU scaling protection by limiting baseline reference points to the 4 most recent runs.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Registers domain parameters, API profiles, and tracks running lists of formulation experiment history.

methods.name: add_experiment_result
methods.description: Appends measured laboratory parameters and CQA responses to the loop's history database.

methods.name: get_api_context_vector
methods.description: Assembles a 6-dimensional physical/thermodynamic context vector representing melting point, density, Carr's index, TPSA, logP, and MW for the API.

methods.name: _enforce_mass_balance
methods.description: Implements formulation mass balances, checking dynamic excipients and scaling them proportionately relative to minimum limits if total percentage exceeds 70%.

methods.name: _transform_objectives
methods.description: Converts quality attributes to a pure maximization space. Keeps dissolution as-is, negates friability, and transforms hardness, CU, and Heckel compressibility to negative absolute target deviations.

methods.name: evaluate_surrogate_calibration
methods.description: Calculates probabilistic model health indicators (CRPS and 95% Confidence Interval Coverage) for fitted GPs.

methods.name: compute_loo_cv_r2
methods.description: Runs Leave-One-Out (LOO) cross-validation, computing localized R^2 scores for each of the 8 surrogate targets.

methods.name: check_convergence
methods.description: Evaluates Pareto front stability and convergence gradients over sequential iterations.

methods.name: suggest_next
methods.description: Core active selection engine. Generates spaced LHS seeds if N < 3. When N >= 3, standardizes inputs, fits 8 independent GPs, solves qLogNEHVI acquisition via SciPy L-BFGS-B, performs conservative posterior projections, and handles Scikit-Learn fallback.

functions.name: compute_pareto_front
functions.description: Computes non-dominated Pareto sets across multi-objective experiment outcomes.

functions.name: _get_active_loop
functions.description: Loads the session's designated ActiveLearningLoop instance from in-memory registers.

functions.name: initialize_domain
functions.description: Endpoint [POST /v1/domain] to spin up a new active session and instantly output the first 3 LHS seeds.

functions.name: add_result
functions.description: Endpoint [POST /v1/experiments/result] to submit physical laboratory outcomes back to the state machine.

functions.name: suggest_next_experiment
functions.description: Endpoint [POST /v1/suggest] to execute Gaussian Process fitting and qLogNEHVI acquisition optimization, producing the next suggested batch.

functions.name: get_pareto_front
functions.description: Endpoint [GET /v1/pareto] to track multi-objective Pareto frontiers.

functions.name: get_session_summary
functions.description: Endpoint [GET /v1/summary] to gather all active learning loop metrics.

functions.name: weibull_model
functions.description: Classic Weibull formulation mapping dissolution percentages over time.

functions.name: fit_weibull_profile
functions.description: Fits experimental dissolution timespans to output Weibull scale (eta) and shape (beta) parameters.

functions.name: compute_scaleup_metrics
functions.description: Calculates shear rates, Reynolds, Froude, and power numbers to scale fluid dynamics across tank factors.

functions.name: ingest_alpha_dataset
functions.description: Ingests historical datasets to construct molecular profiles.

functions.name: ingest_beta_dataset
functions.description: Parses secondary formulation structures and excipient targets.

functions.name: cross_validate_datasets
functions.description: Validates consistency and parameter compatibility across input datasets.
